password.tooShort: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long.

loadFailed.title: Could not retrieve data
loadFailed.description: An error occurred while retrieving the user's information.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your SkyCrew account.

twoFactor.title: Verification code required
twoFactor.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

demo.title: Demo access
demo.description: Choose an account to fill in the form and explore the site in read-only mode.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
twoFactor.incompleteCode: Enter all {{count}} digits of the code.
twoFactor.invalidCode: This code is invalid or has expired. Enter the code your app is showing now.

forgotPassword.title: Forgotten password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address to receive a reset link.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.description: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset email has just been sent. Its link is valid for one hour.

failed.title: Could not send
failed.description: The request could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.description: Choose the password you will use to sign in.

done.title: Password changed
done.description: You can now sign in with your new password.

incomplete.description: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

failed.title: Could not reset the password
failed.description: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

newAccount.title: Activate your account
newAccount.description: Choose your password to finish creating your account.

done.title: Account activated
done.description: Your password has been saved. The sign-in page is about to open.

incomplete.description: This activation link is incomplete. Open it from the invitation email or ask your club for a new one.

failed.title: Could not activate the account
failed.description: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask your club for a new invitation.

maintenance.title: Site under maintenance
maintenance.defaultMessage: We are updating the site. It will be available again very soon.
maintenance.finished: Maintenance should be over. Try again.

notConnected.title: Sign-in required
notConnected.description: Sign in to access this page.
notConnected.footer: Need help? Contact a club administrator.

unauthorized.title: Access denied
unauthorized.description: You do not have permission to access this page.
unauthorized.footer: If you think this is a mistake, contact a club administrator.

error.title: Cannot reach the server
error.description: The service status could not be checked. Check your Internet connection and try again.

available.title: The service is available again
available.description: You are about to be redirected to the sign-in page.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.description: SkyCrew is temporarily unreachable: maintenance or a technical incident.
unavailable.footer: If the problem persists, contact a club administrator.

page.title: Something went wrong
page.description: The page could not be displayed. Try again; if the problem persists, contact a club administrator.

global.title: The application ran into a problem
global.description: An unexpected error is preventing the display. Try again; if the problem persists, contact a club administrator.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist or has been moved.
